# Round 5 evidence/adoption — contract invariants

This is the common Load/operating-clause surface for the new contract set. It cites the [ratified supplement](../../evidence-and-adoption-spec.md) and [frozen handoff](../../decomposition-prompt.md); it does not replace them. Requirement semantics remain in those sources. Every ticket gap table evaluates the applicable clauses below, including explicit inapplicability rather than silence.

## Authority and acceptance

1. **I-01 Source and identity.** Preserve the frozen canonical behavioral contract, supplemental authority, candidate aliases, accepted input bytes and history. Amend changed behavior through the §9.3 ADR/manifest protocol before affected semantics or inference. No generated client/schema edits, new dependency scope, reverse edge, second codec/store/class table or new unadmitted tier.
2. **I-02 Owners and durability.** Kernel semantics stay behind the shared embed boundary; CLI/recipe only orchestrates. Persist through the current fenced writer before projections. Reuse native identity, event kinds, home-plane classes and owning reference enumeration. Proposed local interface names are not already-existing RPC/wire commitments.
3. **I-03 Subject and grades.** Preserve one recoverable launched subject, seal→persist actual finish→execution settlement once→instrument grade→immutable selection/disposition. Pending blocks every declared consumer. Preserve six outcomes, raw grade/veto/availability, authorized correction watermarks, first-subject counts and all-attempt costs; no historical rewrite, recharge or n inflation.
4. **I-04 Treatment and caps.** Preserve retained-view→existing renderer→whole-vector reserve→sealed request→dispatch→usage ordering. Derived token totals, ancestor/outstanding holds and physical use survive logical reversal. Persist actual wall origin and unknown exposure; no silent unbounded dispatch or false containment.
5. **I-05 Methods and missingness.** Use the exact admitted estimator/target/assumptions/direction/seed/draw/family/report path. Native finite-manifest, task-mixture, sharp-null and parity claims remain distinct. Unknown/veto/not-run/short cells cannot improve denominators; no metadata-only inference, fixture efficacy or credible-as-TOST certificate.
6. **I-06 Receipts and readers.** Native profile is a derived index with typed all-planned closure. Preserve producer-independent recipient checks, ordinary/payload-only bytes, loss/access/expiry, exact identities/verdicts and frozen numerical tolerances. Replay is not fresh solving; R0 lifecycle is open/finished. No task/public/adoption claim follows from a top-level process pass.
7. **I-07 Required domains.** D/E/R/P are orthogonal acceptance dimensions, with BM evidence classes stated separately. A source requirement has one primary owner but can have multiple prerequisite/contributing contracts. Completion of a contributing slice does not close its full requirement; all predicates and eventual P/R gates remain in the coverage table. No favorable study effect is required; unexecuted/unadmitted work is unmet.
8. **I-08 Scope and gates.** Preserve six scenarios/22 families/nine later groups and central real study. Optional exercises award no claim if unselected. Exact backend/pins/margins/independence/rights/quotes/consent/publication inputs remain named prerequisites. $0 task/cloud authority until a scoped operator decision; no inherited previous-round permissions, installs, hidden provisioning, outreach or merge authority.

## Operating clauses

- **O-01 Orientation and clock.** Deferrals first; bounded row/spec/ledger reads; applicable nested AGENTS; actual UTC at writing. Reconfirm source anchors at execution. Source files above about 40 KiB require symbol search and bounded reads. Do not pin tests to living counts/status/date values.
- **O-02 State writer and stacking.** One central writer; fresh context per ticket; no overlapping shared-file mutations. Read active manifest order, prior branch and verified chainTip. Only operator merges. Preserve historical ledgers/contracts/readouts; shell/Python writes and actual diff/show verification are mandatory.
- **O-03 Explicit gates.** Pending operator gate is RETURN PASS; failed technical checks are blockedOn. No decision/signature/tick is inferred from silence or a prior gate. HUMAN rows are scheduled by owner/trigger; withheld claims remain visible; second deferral requires explicit operator disposition. Skeletons have no Run line and never dispatch.
- **O-04 Routing guard.** Only the separately approved, narrowly scoped bootstrap tooling task may create/test the retained guard before it exists. All product dispatch subsequently requires the retained supplemental coverage/routing guard and actual chosen launch-path proof before/after boundaries. Reject old GATE-G1 routing, stale signatures, pending gates, missing/duplicate ownership and unguarded accumulating loops. This document is not executable enforcement.
- **O-05 Verification.** Every changed behavior has a regression that fails without it. Run cargo fmt and scoped owning-package tests for code; relevant drift/removability/CI gating/recipient checks follow scope. Restore default helper after tier-off. Record failures, diagnostic reruns, commands and passed/failed/skipped counts. Docs checks do not prove runtime or research. Full CI dispatch remains a maintainer/gate action.
- **O-06 Close evidence.** Worker reads current-head and ancestor PR CI; never treat pending/unknown as green. Update run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/PHASE LOG consistently at true completion with Harness/Skills/Started/Closed/CI metadata. New PHASE LOG entries ≤2 KiB. Root does not back-fill fictional landing evidence.
- **O-07 Validation and history.** Run stock external build-memory/backlog checks separately from repo row tools and the retained supplemental guard. Scope historical compatibility by diagnostic/path/rows, never an arbitrary warning count. Preserve old signed acceptance; require fresh round-specific acceptance. No no-op range or committed-HEAD check may validate uncommitted artifacts by implication.
- **O-08 Production and sensitive material.** No production mutation without an explicit ticket header, scoped authorization, scripted path, pre-state/rollback/verification. Credentials are provided: yes/no only. Follow rights/consent/access/loss handling before any materialization or sharing. Current task authorizes planning only.

## Contract sizing rule

The stated line budget is a split trigger, not an implementation estimate or permission to overrun. Each contract also records estimated context from bounded source slices, spec/AC load, tests and review headroom. At SETUP measure the actual selected worker context; require the estimated total well below half its window. If the bound cannot be established, do not dispatch; review a scoped split. Source file size is not permission to load entire monoliths.

A contract is revisable before execution through scoped decompose-spec review; an executed contract only gains a dated amendment. New substantive design is returned to the authoritative amendment process. No runtime flags are inferred from a line-budget estimate.
